events.summary: Node agents and system DaemonSets only (owner request 2026-11-25: real fixes, or an exact (namespace, kind, name, checks) acceptance whose reason is measured on the live object, never a pattern or an upstream-default reason alone). The live cluster was read-only for this lane; Falco driver mode and every privileged agent's privilege are untouched.

The actionable set was recomputed from the live ConfigAuditReports (CIS-mapped checks minus the existing rules) and each agent was measured read-only: CapEff, Seccomp, NoNewPrivs and UID from /proc status, host path ownership, the node LSM list, and the DaemonSet specs.
